title: Fall Asleep to the Book of Proverbs | KJV Bible Audio for Deep Sleep | 3 Hours, Black Screen
description:
The complete the Book of Proverbs from the King James Version, read slowly and softly for sleep.

All 31 chapters, start to finish. No verse numbers, no music swells, no volume spikes. Peaceful crashing waves roll low underneath the whole way through. The screen goes dark after the first minute so it won't light up your room, and the reading fades out gently at the end instead of stopping cold.

Made for anyone who wants the Word playing while they rest: night owls, early risers, shift workers sleeping through the day, and anyone whose mind won't settle.

"When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet." Proverbs 3:24 (KJV)

Tip: turn off Autoplay (the switch at the bottom of the player) so nothing else starts when the reading ends.

Scripture: King James Version (public domain).
Narration: AI-generated voice, produced and mastered by our team.
